name: video-studio
description: Make and edit videos with Claude using free local tools. One of three pieces released together: this plugin (skills, setup, registrations), the media-toolbox engine (Docker: transcription, TTS and cloned voices, SFX, FLUX images, ffmpeg) and the MangoAI editor (timeline, HyperFrames graphics, render), plus optional DaVinci Resolve (free) and Blender. Start with /studio-setup: Claude installs and checks everything.
